description: Close a notice for the person this token acts for, as the console's close button does. Only a notice with dismissible: true can be closed (a low balance). It stays closed while its id lasts: a low balance that a top-up ends and a later spend brings back has a new id and shows again. Critical notices cannot be closed.

noticeId.description: The notice's id from get_notices, e.g. credits_low:<grant>

name: dismiss_notice
title: Dismiss a workspace notice
